title: mentha × piperita var. crispa
intro: Mentha × piperita var. crispa, commonly known as Corsican mint or Bergamot mint, is a variant of the peppermint plant characterized by its curled leaves. The plant is valued for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to alleviate digestive issues, reduce nausea and headaches, and exhibit anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Mentha × piperita var. crispa include its antispasmodic, carminative, and expectorant properties, which help to soothe muscle spasms, relieve gas and indigestion, and ease respiratory congestion. The bioactive constituents of the plant include menthol, menthone, limonene, and other volatile oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties and aroma.
